Inside the house

The middle of the house is a skylit courtyard. Palms grow out of a shallow channel of water there, between the windows of the rooms.

There are hammocks on the verandas, an outdoor shower in the garden, a clothes line, and a rack for your boards.

The afternoon

On the roof

The terrace up top is shaded with thatch, and has a swing seat, hammocks, benches and tables. Beyond the palms, the sea.

Sunset

By the beach

The guesthouse is tucked away from the busy Galle–Matara road, right next to the beach.

Next to the guesthouse is a large open grassed area overlooking the beach, where the friendly locals and tourists alike gather to watch the surf, play cricket, socialise and enjoy beautiful sunrises and sunsets.

Until 22:00

The restaurant upstairs

A long covered room on the upper floor, with cushioned benches, low tables and a view of the sea. All meals, snacks and drinks are available. Breakfast comes with some rates and not with others.

The restaurant has its own Google listing, Coconut Surf Restaurant (2nd floor), where it's rated 4.6 from 39 reviews.

The restaurant upstairs is open every day from 7:30 to 22:00.

The Eranga family home

Coconut Surf Inn is the Eranga family home, so staying here means you will experience the endless warm smiles and kind hospitality of the gracious host Chinthaka and his family.

Chinthaka has been a host on Airbnb for 13 years.

From 7:30, the break

Coconuts, a consistent A-frame reef break, is in front of the guesthouse. Plantations is a more mellow wave, a 100 m walk up the beach.

According to the Sri Lanka Travel Pages surf guide, the season at Coconut Point runs from November to April.

Getting here

Koggala Airport is 11 km away. If you want a taxi from the airport, let us know and we'll arrange one. There's a charge.

The nearest train station is Kumbalgama, about a 13-minute walk. Midigama station is 1.4 km away. Booking.com puts the centre of Weligama 3.3 km from the house.

On Google Maps, look for Coconut Surf Inn Guest House and Restaurant.
